resources.string: Review what data stays on your device and what is sent to connected services.
YouTubeYar has no app-owned backend server. Features that need external services send only the data required for that feature.

Local storage: settings, entered API keys, channel preferences, checklist progress, lesson progress and AI history are stored on your device using Android app storage. Clearing app data or uninstalling the app removes this local data.
YouTube Data API: when you analyze a channel, its handle or channel ID and your YouTube API key are sent to Google to retrieve public channel and video statistics. Do not use an unrestricted API key.
AI providers: if you enable Gemini, OpenAI or DeepSeek, the topic and prompt you submit are sent to the provider you selected using your API key. Offline mode does not send prompts to an AI provider.

Advertising: when you configure and enable Tapsell, its SDK may process device, network and advertising-related information to request and measure ads. Review Tapsell’s privacy terms for details. Ads are not requested when the configured ad zones or app key are missing.

Purchases: subscription checkout and purchase records are handled by the installed app store. The app verifies signed purchase data locally with the public key you enter in Settings; the public key is not a password.
Your choices: you can disable online AI by selecting Offline, remove API keys in Settings, and stop using advertising features. No app account is required.
